name: Accidental Assignment
source: Office-centric erotic visual novel, where you (a low-level spy in an elite agency) infiltrate a start-up company on the request of the CEO’s father. Come find out what shenanigans wait for you in this slice-of-life erotica – sprinkled with comedy and mystery.​
translation: 這是一部以辦公室為舞臺的成人視覺小說。你是菁英機構裡的一名基層間諜，受執行長父親的委託，潛入一家新創公司。來看看這部融入喜劇與懸疑元素的成人日常故事，會帶來怎樣的鬧劇。
